Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the purchasing of fuel by agencies performing the metropolitan transportation function.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the purchasing of fuel; adding a new section tochapter 35.58 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds and declares thatagencies performing the metropolitan transportation function shouldhave substantial flexibility in acquiring fuel to obtain predictabilityand control of fuel costs, and to maximize the use of renewable fuels.The legislature declares that section 2 of this act is intended toallow metropolitan municipal corporations and counties that haveassumed the rights, powers, functions, and obligations of metropolitanmunicipal corporations under chapter 36.56 RCW, to explore andimplement strategies in the performance of the metropolitantransportation function that are designed to reduce the overall cost offuel and mitigate the impact of market fluctuations and pressure onboth shortterm and longterm fuel costs.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.58 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In performing the metropolitan transportation function, p. 1 HB 2746metropolitan municipal corporations and counties that have assumed therights, powers, functions, and obligations of metropolitan municipalcorporations under chapter 36.56 RCW, may explore and implementstrategies designed to reduce the overall cost of fuel and mitigate theimpact of market fluctuations and pressure on both shortterm and longterm fuel costs. These strategies may include, but are not limited to,futures contracts, hedging, swap transactions, option contracts,costless collars, and longterm storage.
